title: Benefits team needs your login
scenario: A message from “HR Benefits” says open enrollment data did not migrate correctly and asks employees to reauthenticate through a portal using corporate SSO plus a personal tax/social-security number.

answers.A: Check the official HR calendar/announcement channel to see whether a migration issue exists.
answers.B: Use the portal because benefits enrollment legitimately involves personal identifiers.
answers.C: Use the HR system from the company intranet or contact HR through a known channel before entering sensitive data.

explanation: Legitimate HR processes do involve sensitive data, making impersonation especially effective. Start from the HR system you already trust.
proTip: Sensitive context requires a stronger channel, not weaker skepticism.
